arguments.title: VideoPrism: A Foundational Visual Encoder for Video Understanding
key_claims: A frozen video encoder retains spatiotemporal outputs and combines semantic global/local distillation. It provides a useful temporal-representation comparator in principle. Its paper explicitly limits long-video understanding: the encoder consumes16 sampled frames. The official implementation currently uses JAX/Flax and lists PyTorch support as a TODO, so it is deferred from the first PyTorch pilot. Large and partly private pretraining data leave overlap and transfer questions; no stage-light or precise chromatic timing result is established.
